column1: *Crystal Cross Medals are needed for the "Legendary Aqua Gem Stone" that you need to finish each of your level 95 Awakened Sets - You do not need the previous Lv70 and Lv80 awaken sets to awaken a Lv95 set.

Listed below are some of the quickest ways for you to get CCM, dependding on your "Monster Conquest Achievements" aka stress level so make sure to change level often when farming
- 4 Trials of the Dimension: Completing both runs will give you about 800 CCM per day depending on your "Monster Conquest Achievements" stress level.
- Dream of Destruction Lv90 & Lv95: Killing the bosses will provide you CCM, as well as the random rewards upon completing the dungeons now contains 5x "18x Crystal Cross Medals".
- Viroona City Ruins (Daily): This will give you 10x "18x Crystal Cross Medals" for completing the quest and simply requires you to run through the dungeon once.
- Quantum Physics Lab: This dungeon has 4 bosses. Completing the dungeon will give you 60 CCM (+72 CCM if you do the Class Drop) per run, totalling 1320 CCM for 10 runs a day.
- Path of Destiny: Farming with PoD is a fast but expensive method of getting CCM. Landing on the green patch "EXP - Unexpected Gains" will give you a decent chunk of CCM.
- Repeatables: Whispering Woods, Singing Valley, Roaming Hills and Crystal Utopia all have repeatables to farm 54 CCM per turn-in.

You have always been needing a lot of EP to complete your "Legendary Achievements" but now the expenses are doubled as there are level 80 and level 90 "Legendary Achievements" brought exclusively to this server! Buying EP from other players can be pricey, so it's important to farm them yourself as well if you want to save up on gold.

- Gambling Altars: If you're into gambling then try your luck at either the Gem Altar or the Crystal Altar! Both altars provides a chance of winning 2x "129 Eternal Coins" and is the main source of EP on this server.
- "Service Off. Asst. Goth": Located in Aven this man gives you 1x "4 Eternal Coins" every 2 hours for doing... absolutely nothing! Make sure you visit him regularly.

- Path of Destiny: This is once again a fast but expensive method to farm EP. The brown patch "Unexpected Gains" is the box that gives the most EP and the red patch "Secret Treasure" at the end also gives good loot so make sure to finish your PoD maps!

- Temple Knights Trial: Randomly dropped boxes from the Temple Knight's trial gives you 5x "10 Eternal Coins". Just doing this dungeon once a day every day can really soften the blow to your virtual wallet.
- Temple Arena: Each time you kill a boss it may drop 10x "10 Eternal Coins". To be confirmed, someone do it and tell me plz I just remember it's a lot :^(
Here's some tips and tricks to farm your precious gold in an effective way:

column2: - Mainline quests: Besides being the main source of EXP for your character to level up these quests also tends to give you a decent chunk of gold once you reach higher levels, enough to at least upgrade your weapon to +10 (but don't spend too much gold on temporary weapons!!). You'll also get a lot of Resistance Gems from quests, especially book quests, which you can sell for some quick cash or save for later use.

- Gem Altar and Crystal Altar: Gambling altars are almost always guaranteed profit - if you don't become greedy. Always take anything that's tradeable and/or lands on a bonus. Consumable items like Corona's Stardust or Corona's Essences usually sells fast.

- Selling "Class Level" Runs: Once you're geared enough to run safely and quickly in "Dimension of Souls" or "Dragonside Ridge" there will almost always be someone willing to buy runs to level up their classes.

- Racial Crafting: This method might take a lot of resources and a whole lot of time before you can efficiently produce enough products to sell, but it's all worth it in the end as it means you can earn gold AND won't have to depend on other players once you might need the products yourself.

- Shaxia Fae Fields (0/10): This is the fastest and easiest way to get gold for anyone stuck at around level 90-100. Located in Shaxia Basin, this dungeon will bring in an average of 400-1000g/run by selling the loot, depending on your luck. Use high damaging AoE classes like Blade Acrobat or Mecha Ares to complete your runs faster.
- Crystal Utopian Realm (0/10): This "remake" of Shaxian Fae Fields located in Crystal Utopia brings in an average of 400-1000g/run.
- Viroona City Ruins (0/10): This custom dungeon is similar to Shaxian Fae Fields and located in Viroona Vale. It's a harder and longer dungeon but gives a similar amount of gold (plus CCM),
- Palace of Dreams (0/10): This is a higher level dungeon located in Roaming Hills and an alternatie way to farm gold, bringing in an average of 700-1100g/run.
- Ruins of Ages (0/10): This is a higher level dungeon located in Whispering Woods and an alternative way to farm gold, bringing in an average of 200-400g/run.
- Dragon Keep's (0/10): This is a higher level dungeon located in Singing Valley and an alternatie way to farm gold, bringing in an average of 500-700g/run.

- Territory War Salary: At level 110+ (?) the salary from winning a territory provides you 200-300 free gold per territory (max 3 territories/guild). Gear up and participate in PvP, help your guild get those territories and reap the rewards!

column7: The "Lv75 Trials" found in Aven can be a good free source of Eden Crystals (NT) and doesn't require you to have the best of gear. If you have a class drop slave you can easily do all these runs and get about 36x Eden Crystals (NT) a day. Remember, if you are patient and not greedy, Eden Crystals are guaranteed profit.
Note: These Eden Crystals are NT aka non-tradeable which means they cannot be sold, only rolled by yourself for a chance to profit.
